Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: Oh, hello...
Sorry, I can't right now.
I... oh... are... um... eurgh...
Hello? Hello? Is somebody in there?
Who... what... are you?
Oh great. A magical talking statue. Just what I needed today!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: No skvělé. Magická mluvící socha. Přesně to mi dneska chybělo!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: I am... just... an echo...
The magic... is almost... all gone...
I have a message... for the Legendary Adventurer...
Well, I'm legendary and an adventurer.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: No, legendární jsem a dobrodruh taky.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: You've got the wrong person.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: To si mě s někým pleteš.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: I don't know if I'm who you're looking for. But if I can help you, I will.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: Nevím, jestli jsem ten, koho hledáš. Ale pokud můžu pomoct, pomůžu.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: You... you are the one I seek...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: Ty... ty jsi ten, koho hledám...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: But you've <Lore>forgotten</Lore>...
The Crafter... she sends an urgent message... She is in desperate need of help...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: Tvůrkyně... posílá naléhavý vzkaz... Zoufale potřebuje pomoc...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: A dreaded villain draws ever nearer... Please... you must save her...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: Obávaný padouch se blíží... Prosím... musíš ji zachránit...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: The Crafter...?
A dreaded villain...?
Someone needs my help? I'll do whatever I can.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: Někdo potřebuje mou pomoc? Udělám, co bude v mých silách.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: No... time...
<Lore>Find the Sunken Echoes.</Lore>
<Lore>Awaken the Guardians.</Lore>
And <Lore>reach the kingdom across the sea</Lore>.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: A <Lore>dostaň se do království za mořem</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: How do I do all that? Please!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: Jak to mám všechno udělat? Prosím!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: Um, okay, thanks?
Sunken Echoes??? Guardians??? Why do you talk in riddles???
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: Potopené ozvěny??? Strážci??? Proč mluvíš v hádankách???

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: Already... have... all you need...
<Lore>Put me in the water...</Lore> and I will open the way...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: <Lore>Dej mě do vody...</Lore> a já ti otevřu cestu...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.en: ...dive in... and swim to the kingdom...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Messenger/Guard.cz: ...skoč dovnitř... a doplav až do království...
